text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...? What's the matter, Cheval-chan? Is 
something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Are you having trouble with something? If 
you don't mind me, I'd love to help!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ...... ...A-Actually... um... I was 
just thinking how nervous I am for the 
upcoming class party...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh! The class meetup... wasn't that the 
one where we all go bowling and then have 
a BBQ?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Um... I just don't have the 
confidence to talk or hang out with 
everyone very well...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see. ...Ah, in that case, want to 
do a dry run!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
First off, how about the four of us—me, 
Dia-chan, and Cla-chan—play some games 
together tonight and hang out—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then tomorrow night, we'll invite a few 
more people, and the night after that, 
even more... That way, we can ease you 
into it gradually!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...! S-So amazing...! To think he'd try 
so positively to work something out... I 
have to do my best too...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
M-Maybe I'll give it a try...! ...Ah, 
but—will that many people show up? 
Everyone tends to be busy at night and 
all—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No worries, no worries! I'll do my best to 
gather them! Leave it to me!
